title: Bootstrap fails with IncompleteRead — transient network disruption on aarch64 runners
error_summary: HTTP connection broken mid-transfer (IncompleteRead) during package resolution on aarch64 runners, causing fatal bootstrap failure
suggested_resolution_summary: Retry the failed jobs; no code change required — this is a transient network issue
confidence_justification: The error message directly identifies the cause (IncompleteRead during HTTP transfer). Supporting evidence: (1) an earlier recoverable network error (RemoteDisconnected for charset_normalizer) on the same CPU job confirms network instability on the runner; (2) the two jobs failed at different progress points (77% vs 84%) with different byte counts, confirming non-determinism; (3) other aarch64 bootstrap jobs for smaller collections succeeded in the same pipeline run, consistent with a transient issue that is more likely to hit longer-running jobs.
